title: MiniQMT StrategyPackage binding cannot roll over to next-day selection runs
description:
Expected: A virtual miniQMT strategy should support an explicit package-binding lifecycle for daily operation: keep historical bindings auditable, retire/pause/replace the previous ACTIVE binding when a new trade_date or selection_run_id is activated, enforce one ACTIVE binding at a time, and expose clear operator/API behavior for idempotent same-day rebinding versus next-day rollover.
Actual: QmtStrategyPackageBindingService.bind() always creates a new binding with binding_status=ACTIVE. The repository and migration enforce only one ACTIVE binding per strategy, but no service/API path retires or replaces the existing active binding. After one strategy is bound for 2026-05-19, a normal next-day run that needs a new selection_run_id/trade_date can fail on duplicate active binding or require manual database manipulation.
reproduce_command: rg -n "create_package_binding|get_active_package_binding|BindingStatus.ACTIVE|active package binding already exists|ux_qmt_strategy_active_binding|package-bindings" backend/services/qmt_strategy_ledger backend/routers/qmt_strategy_ledger.py backend/migrations/qmt_strategy_ledger_20260518.sql backend/tests/qmt_strategy_ledger -S
required_verification: Unit test: binding the same strategy/package/selection_run idempotently does not create duplicate ACTIVE rows.
Unit test: replacing an ACTIVE binding with a new trade_date or selection_run retires or pauses the old binding and activates the new one.
Unit test: historical bindings remain queryable after rollover and active-binding lookup returns only the current binding.
Router/API test: operator can request explicit replace/rollover behavior and receives actionable errors for unsafe duplicate binding.
Migration/repository test: active binding uniqueness remains enforced while lifecycle transitions are supported.
closure_requirements: Daily miniQMT strategy operation does not require manual SQL to bind the next selection run.
The active binding lifecycle has explicit ACTIVE/PAUSED/RETIRED or equivalent transitions with audit metadata.
Order preview/build uses the current active binding only.
The lifecycle behavior is documented in validation evidence before declaring next-day readiness.

events.note: Root cause hypothesis: binding service implements create-only active binding semantics; lifecycle transition operations are absent.
Business impact: P0 for multi-day miniQMT strategy simulation because tomorrow's strategy package/selection evidence needs a clean rollover path before the market opens.

Expected design: same package + same selection_run may be idempotent; new selection_run/trade_date must either replace active binding with audit event or fail with actionable API requiring explicit retire/replace confirmation.

Required verification: same-day idempotent bind does not create duplicate active rows, next-day replace retires prior active binding, historical bindings remain queryable, and order preview uses the current active binding only.
Required verification: migration/repository comments and tests reflect the lifecycle semantics; no direct DB edits are needed for daily operation.
Expanded from miniQMT issue coverage audit with explicit verification and closure requirements before code fixes.
Mirrored BUG-053 to GitHub issue #56 via gh CLI from miniQMT issue coverage audit.
Confirmed GitHub issue #56 is OPEN and label-synced (bug, status:open, P0, severity:p0, module:qmt_strategy_ledger, risk:trading_binding_lifecycle) before fix worktree creation.

Implemented explicit MiniQMT StrategyPackage binding lifecycle: idempotent same-selection bind, explicit replace_active rollover retiring previous ACTIVE binding with lifecycle metadata, active-only order build guard, and router 409 for unsafe duplicate active binding. Interim validation: targeted qmt_strategy_ledger package/repository/router/selection tests 28 passed; full qmt_strategy_ledger suite 66 passed.
